title: Use structured SimpleMatch for quote-bearing stale-label probes
failure_signature: A native fixed-string search split a multiword quoted JSON pattern into path arguments and emitted file-not-found errors.
trigger_preconditions: A pattern containing JSON quotes and spaces
candidate_workaround: Enumerate owner-scoped text files and use PowerShell Select-String -SimpleMatch with the exact fragments.
recurrence_guard: Reject any stale-label result accompanied by native path errors and prefer structured matching for multiword quoted fragments.
rollback: Discard the invalid zero-hit result and rerun only the read-only owner-scoped probe.
protected_gates: No stale-label pass from an errored command
scope_boundary: This method validates stale-label string matching only and does not replace semantic review.
